detail.longDescription: A paper system and 28 hours a week When John Cabanela became the interim bookkeeper at Theatre Passe Muraille in April 2024, he inherited a paper-heavy bookkeeping system built around QuickBooks Desktop. "I was not about that at all," he says. He began moving the theatre's financial processes to the cloud, starting with a transition from Excel spreadsheets to Google Sheets.
